name: ModelVariant770_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant770_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (header 770's entry, the header-766 effect run as two streams: each stream draws a gouraud trail between two parts of the active slot, then a flash that spins and widens, a burst of two stars, falling sparks and a fan of light columns in front of the slot. The slot's ambient level dips while the trails run and comes back once the second stream's burst starts); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-787 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant787_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
